Package cgb.transfer.entity

Class BatchTransfer

java.lang.Object
cgb.transfer.entity.BatchTransfer
@Entity public class BatchTransfer extends Object
Classe de mapping d'un virement de lot entre la base H2 et l'application JAVA.
